Name: Rhao92's The Bus Stream Deck Plugin
Description: Free Stream Deck plugin for The Bus by TML Studios with live telemetry, vehicle controls, navigation, full panels, and vehicle status displays.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ful.Name: Full panel
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ful.Tooltip: Full-width dashboard for timetable, vehicle, and navigation across all four Stream Deck + dials.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.tim.Name: Timetable · Single panel
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.tim.Tooltip: One timetable action for stop, arrival, departure, deviation, in-game time, or status.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.tim.Name: Timetable · Key
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.tim.Tooltip: One timetable key for stop, arrival, departure, deviation, in-game time, status, or stop request.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.sto.Name: Timetable · Stop request
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.sto.Tooltip: Shows an active stop request from telemetry with synchronized 2 Hz flashing.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Name: Navigation
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Tooltip: Preferred navigation key: dynamic maneuver arrow and matching distance from the same NAV-07-locked maneuver.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Name: Navigation · Maneuver distance
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Tooltip: Hidden legacy display for maneuver distance within the beta UUID family.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Name: Navigation · Next stop
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Tooltip: Shows the next mission-relevant stop and its distance along the route.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Name: Navigation · Remaining distance
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Tooltip: Shows the remaining distance along the active route to the end of the line.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Name: Navigation · Route progress
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Tooltip: Shows measured progress along the complete line from the first to the final stop.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Name: Navigation · ETA
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Tooltip: Shows the estimated arrival at the next stop based on remaining distance and observed driving speed.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Name: Navigation · Predicted delta
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Tooltip: Compares the clearly identified ETA estimate with the scheduled arrival; the official timetable deviation remains separate.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Name: Navigation · Prediction confidence
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Tooltip: Shows data status and confidence of the current ETA prediction for isolated practical testing.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Name: Navigation · Save diagnostics
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.nav.Tooltip: Beta diagnostics: saves the last 60 seconds as TXT in the Documents subfolder Projects\The Bus\NaviDebug.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.veh.Name: Vehicle · Display
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.veh.Tooltip: Configurable key for speed, speed limit, power or trip consumption, and battery level.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.veh.Name: Vehicle · Speed limit
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.veh.Tooltip: Shows the currently reported speed limit as a road sign.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.veh.Name: Vehicle · Power
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.veh.Tooltip: Shows available direct power-meter output; on an eBus without a power meter, shows driving consumption from confirmed battery energy and actual distance traveled. Pressing the key resets only this trip average.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.veh.Name: Vehicle · Battery
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.veh.Tooltip: Shows the reported eCitaro battery level from DisplayFuel as a percentage.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.hva.Name: Climate · Control
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.hva.Tooltip: Vehicle-independent climate key for on/off, target temperature ±1 °C, or the actually reported ventilation control. Display and commands are derived dynamically from buttons and actions.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.hva.Name: Climate · Dial
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.hva.Tooltip: Configurable Stream Deck + dial for airflow, target temperature, or fan speed. Commands and display follow the vehicle's real controls.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.doo.Name: Doors · Control
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.doo.Tooltip: Configurable key for all doors, doors 1 to 4, door clearance, or automatic door closing. The display follows confirmed telemetry.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.doo.Name: Doors · Door clearance
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.doo.Tooltip: Toggles door clearance; the display follows confirmed ButtonLight telemetry only.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.aut.Name: Doors · Automatic closing
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.aut.Tooltip: Toggles automatic closing of the rear doors and displays only the confirmed vehicle state.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.gea.Name: Driving · Controls
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.gea.Tooltip: One configurable key for gear selection, indicators, hazard lights, parking or stop brake, retarder, and windshield wipers. Display and control remain fully telemetry-driven.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ind.Name: Driving · Indicators
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ind.Tooltip: Configurable key for left indicator, right indicator, or hazard lights. The flashing phase follows the real in-game lamp values.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ign.Name: Driving · Ignition
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ign.Tooltip: Hold as in the bus. Offline, off, ignition, and engine follow EngineStarted/IgnitionEnabled only; contradictory long-press intermediate values are filtered.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.par.Name: Driving · Brakes
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.par.Tooltip: Configurable key for the parking brake or stop brake. Display and control follow confirmed vehicle telemetry only.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ret.Name: Driving · Retarder
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ret.Tooltip: Shows the actual retarder lever level and uses only retarder events reported by the vehicle. Level up/down, off, or direct level selection can be configured.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.sun.Name: Driving · Sun blind
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.sun.Tooltip: Press and hold to move the driver's sun blind using reported window-shade events; release to stop. Direction and display follow confirmed state only.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.wip.Name: Driving · Windshield wiper
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.wip.Tooltip: Shows the actual wiper level and sends WiperUp or WiperDown depending on configuration. No command is sent at confirmed end positions.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.kne.Name: Boarding · Kneeling
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.kne.Tooltip: Configurable key for manual or automatic kneeling.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ram.Name: Boarding · Wheelchair ramp
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ram.Tooltip: Operates the ramp and uses telemetry to show locked, ready, or extended.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ext.Name: Lights · Exterior lighting
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ext.Tooltip: Configurable exterior-light key. Light-switch up/down and high beam send mapped events; daytime, parking, headlights, and fog lights remain telemetry-only displays without a confirmed individual event.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.pas.Name: Lights · Passenger compartment
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.pas.Tooltip: Directly selects Off or On and, where confirmed for the vehicle, Dimmed or Bright using confirmed events and states only.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.tic.Name: Ticketing · ATRON control
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.tic.Tooltip: Operates confirmed ATRON keys only: select on-board computer, reported coin keys, and Take Cash Money. Ticket, price, payment, or receipt data are not displayed without real Sales telemetry.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.gea.Name: Driving · Gear D
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.gea.Tooltip: Engages gear D. The active display follows confirmed gear-selection telemetry only.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.gea.Name: Driving · Gear N
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.gea.Tooltip: Engages gear N. The active display follows confirmed gear-selection telemetry only.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.gea.Name: Driving · Gear R
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.gea.Tooltip: Engages gear R. The active display follows confirmed gear-selection telemetry only.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ind.Name: Driving · Left indicator
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ind.Tooltip: Operates the left indicator. State and real bright/dark phase follow IndicatorState and Light Indicator Left.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ind.Name: Driving · Right indicator
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.ind.Tooltip: Operates the right indicator. State and real bright/dark phase follow IndicatorState and Light Indicator Right.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.war.Name: Driving · Hazard lights
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.war.Tooltip: Toggles the hazard lights. State and real bright/dark phase follow WarningLights and LED Warning.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.all.Name: Doors · All doors
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.all.Tooltip: Opens all confirmed closed doors or selectively closes open and moving doors; movement flashes based on telemetry.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.doo.Name: Doors · Door 1
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.doo.Tooltip: Opens or closes door 1; state and flashing animation follow confirmed door telemetry only.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.doo.Name: Doors · Door 2
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.doo.Tooltip: Opens or closes door 2; state and flashing animation follow confirmed door telemetry only.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.doo.Name: Doors · Door 3
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.doo.Tooltip: Opens or closes door 3; state and flashing animation follow confirmed door telemetry only.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.doo.Name: Doors · Door 4
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.doo.Tooltip: Opens or closes door 4; state and flashing animation follow confirmed door telemetry only.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.kne.Name: Boarding · Kneeling
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.kne.Tooltip: Operates kneeling; the display follows the actual suspension position.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.aut.Name: Boarding · Auto kneeling
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.aut.Tooltip: Toggles automatic kneeling. Button and indicator lamp are interpreted inversely; missing telemetry remains offline.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.pas.Name: Lights · Passenger compartment
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.pas.Tooltip: Toggles passenger lighting or advances to the next real light level, depending on the vehicle. The display shows only confirmed states.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.pas.Name: Lights · Passenger compartment dimmer
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.pas.Tooltip: Selects the dimmer passenger-light setting only when the vehicle provides a separate confirmed control; the display remains telemetry-driven.

de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.pas.Name: Lights · Passenger compartment brighter
de.rhao92.thebus-telemetry-interface.pas.Tooltip: Selects the brighter passenger-light setting only when the vehicle provides a separate confirmed control; the display remains telemetry-driven.
